newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe eases forex rules on dual-listed stocks.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe eases forex rules on dual-listed stocks.

text.p: Dual-listed stocks can now be transferred from a foreign register to the Zimbabwean exchange and in certain cases proceeds can qualify for remittance outside Zimbabwe, the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe said on Wednesday.
But once registered locally such shares may not be transferred back to an external register, the bank added.

The bank said where that acquisition of such shares from a foreign exchange was funded from external sources or individual foreign currency accounts, proceeds from their sale on the local exchange would qualify for remittance outside Zimbabwe.

"It is therefore no longer necessary for authorised dealers to submit applications to exchange control for the transfer to Zimbabwe, sale and subsequent remittance of sale proceeds of dual quoted shares," it said.

Dual-listed stocks on the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange include gold producer Ashanti (also quoted in London and Montreal), Wankie Colliery (also listed in London and Johannesburg) and hotel and supermarkets group Meikles Africa (listed in London).
"The Reserve Bank has made a very important development, something not even South Africa has done yet. Zimbabwe is looking to foreign investors' interests," said one Johannesburg-based analyst.
